lexpilot-proactive-legal-clarification.gallerySummary: Ask for missing case facts before predicting legal claims. Evaluated in Chinese civil consultation, not streaming perception.

figure.alt: LexPilot comparison of direct prediction and proactive fact elicitation

properagent-memory-driven-proactivity.gallerySummary: Formerly ProPerAgent / ProPerMem. Retrieve personal memories, gate whether they justify an interruption, then deliver a timely reminder—or stay silent. Includes windowed and streaming implementations.

release.detail: Public inference/retrieval/evaluation harness plus RL scaffolding under CC-BY-NC-4.0 (noncommercial). 800 ungated evaluation histories; sample file HEAD 200. Ego4D videos require separate access. No post-trained checkpoints or complete paper-results recipe verified. arXiv remains October 21 v2.

proactgen-video-clarification.gallerySummary: Use generated visual evidence to decide which missing preference to clarify before refining a video-generation prompt. Not a streaming assistant.

figure.alt: ProactGen overview contrasting prompt rewriting with proactive preference clarification

safe-pro-cross-modal-inquiry.gallerySummary: Detect a safety-critical missing premise across image and text, then ask a targeted clarification rather than guessing the user's intent.

figure.alt: SAFE-PRO Figure 1 showing implicit reasoning risk and intent-level ambiguity

surgstreamer-request-driven-monitoring.gallerySummary: Convert a 1-FPS surgical stream into structured tool, action and phase state. Rules or a pointer controller trigger a standing request; this is not autonomous clinical need discovery.

figure.alt: SurgStreamer Figure 1 walkthrough of request-conditioned event detection and alert timing

release.detail: New code, benchmark definitions, splits and protocol history are promised upon publication. Public source videos are not a release of this pipeline.

p3i-proactive-video-assistants.gallerySummary: Evaluate perception, hazard prediction and intervention with content-plus-timing scores and redundant-response penalties. SFT + RL trains a Qwen3-VL-4B response/silence policy.

figure.alt: P3IBench overview of perception, prediction and intervention capabilities

release.detail: Inference/evaluation scripts and ungated benchmark JSON/video files are public. No P3I-Assistant-4B checkpoint or training pipeline was verified in the linked repositories.

pam-proactive-robot-assistance.gallerySummary: A finite-state memory of personal routines guides a VLM's task/NO_ACT choice; a VLA executes. Daily reflection edits the memory, not model weights.

figure.alt: PAM overview of task prediction, VLA execution and procedural memory reflection

release.detail: Linked repository is reachable but contains project-page assets, demos, an example FSM and helper tools—not the complete robot implementation or an evaluation dataset.

masp-proactive-dialogue-self-play.gallerySummary: Mentalized adversarial self-play trains proactive dialogue policies against more challenging users, rather than only cooperative simulated users.

figure.alt: MASP mentalizer training, behavior cloning and alternating self-play framework

attrify-soft-attribute-clarification.gallerySummary: Clarification turns subjective attributes such as originality into executable criteria that better match a user's intended meaning.

figure.alt: AttriFy overview of ambiguity estimation and interactive attribute construction
figure.caption: Figure 1 · Editorial caption: AttriFy measures interpretive ambiguity and uses clarification to turn subjective descriptions into executable attributes.

duplexact-content-grounded-interruption.gallerySummary: The Help/Safety Interrupt subset tests taking the floor with useful help or warnings. The entire full-duplex benchmark is not a proactive-assistance benchmark.

figure.alt: DuplexAct interaction actions, triggering conditions and follow-through behaviors
figure.caption: Figure 1 · Editorial caption: Interaction actions are evaluated through their immediate execution and subsequent follow-through. Help and safety interruptions are the proactive subsets.

streamingjev-proactive-physical-ai.gallerySummary: Separate a streaming timing gate from an asynchronous response model. Both observe continuously; a gate opens speech or typed device calls without stopping observation.

figure.alt: ProAgent architecture with StreamingJev timing model, response model and device execution feedback

release.detail: No public implementation, StreamingJev weights or new training-data release was verified from the paper's linked resources. Evaluation on public benchmarks is not a new data release.

uncertainty-proactive-assistant-alignmen.displayTitle: What Don't I Know About User's Preferences?
uncertainty-proactive-assistant-alignmen.gallerySummary: Use uncertainty about user preferences to calibrate proactive assistance; a personalization and alignment perspective, not a streaming model.

reqclarifybench-repository-requirements.gallerySummary: Evaluate whether coding agents ask for missing requirements rather than silently guessing during repository-level software development.

egovoice-proactive-spoken-assistance.gallerySummary: Train MiniCPM-o 4.5 to choose Listen or Speak on egocentric audio/video. SFT + DPO refines timing and restraint under a supplied task recipe.

figure.alt: EgoVoice first-person multimodal stream, silence or intervention decision and spoken guidance

release.detail: Official project page schedules code, models and data for November 2026. A base-model release is not an EgoVoice checkpoint release.

cleat-value-guided-clarification.gallerySummary: Learn when clarification is worth its interaction cost, using value-guided decisions rather than a fixed ask-first rule.

cowriter-proactive-coauthoring.gallerySummary: UI events trigger workflow guidance and author engagement. A monitor, leader and reviewer support human-led writing instead of only generating a draft.

apa-long-term-preference-acquisition.gallerySummary: Ask for a missing preference when its expected benefit across future tasks outweighs effort and disclosure costs. Controlled simulation, not live web deployment.

figure.alt: APA framework for budgeted long-term preference acquisition

proactegomem-ambient-memory.gallerySummary: Query-free ambient memory: notify, or start and stop a memory tool. Separates useful timing from subsequent recall; a benchmark, not a new backbone.

figure.alt: ProactEgoMem ambient-memory assistance in daily life and laboratories

release.detail: Code and metadata are public. Dev annotations overlap test; full test labels are withheld. Source videos require access to upstream datasets.

dive-proactive-intervention.gallerySummary: Its proactive-intervention subset tests useful speech triggered by visual or semantic cues. Timing, participation and content are separate; other duplex tasks are not all proactive.

pace-response-timing.gallerySummary: Build a watch plan, sample informative evidence, check stability/grounding/completion, then emit. Training-free response timing under a standing question.

figure.alt: PACE watch-plan, perception, verification and emission framework

promemagent-prospective-memory.gallerySummary: Retrieve event- and time-based prospective cues to act on delayed intentions. Evaluated on discrete sensory contexts, not a native continuous wearable stream.

figure.alt: ProMemAgent prospective-cue memory retrieval and proactive reasoning

pitch-multiparty-intervention-timing.gallerySummary: When should a fixed useful message enter a group chat—or be withheld? Participant judgments preserve acceptable timing windows and disagreements.

figure.alt: PITCH conversation and participant timing-judgment collection

visual-proactive-math-tutoring.gallerySummary: Periodic paper views support repair, transition help, or waiting. A 117-adult study of contextual tutoring, not a new streaming foundation model.

figure.alt: Visual proactive tutoring system and assistance conditions

release.detail: The paper describes released materials, but the linked repository currently contains only a README promising a future dataset release.

clariedge-grounded-clarification.gallerySummary: Learn when a RAG query needs clarification, including ambiguities exposed by retrieved documents. Hard negatives discourage unnecessary questions.

figure.alt: ClariEdge clarification in pre-retrieval and post-retrieval RAG

release.detail: The announced dataset API returned HTTP 401 without credentials. Public data files and the trained LoRA were not verified.

ask-less-attention-budgets.gallerySummary: Interruption budgets and memory-guided question review distinguish asking less from imposing less effort. Adjacent clarification governance, not streaming perception.

figure.alt: Memory-guided review agent routing questions through a budget and self-review gate
figure.caption: Figure 2 · Editorial caption: Discretionary questions pass through a budget check and memory-guided review; required requests and tool calls follow separate routes.

prov-mem-streaming-response.gallerySummary: Separate temporal triggering, instructional prompting and duplicate filtering around a frozen VLM. Controls emission cost; does not establish personal-need discovery.

figure.alt: ProV-Mem three-tier trigger, instruction and episodic memory framework

askstream-streaming-clarification.gallerySummary: Choose WAIT, ASK or ANSWER as evidence arrives. Ask for missing visual information, concepts or preferences before answering a supplied question.

figure.alt: AskStream overview of wait, ask and answer under streaming uncertainty

release.detail: Evaluation and annotation tools plus public task JSON/video files. Native streaming adapters are user-supplied; no newly trained model or reproduced scores are claimed.

streamvibe-evolving-user-intent.gallerySummary: Track active intents, task progress and prior replies while deciding when to help. Tests explicit, implicit and changing goals in physical and digital videos.

figure.alt: StreamVibe explicit, implicit and evolving intent interaction overview

release.detail: Official project page says Code/Hugging Face soon, pending internal approval. The relative seven-day promise is not a verified release date.

syncpro-dual-stream-reasoning.gallerySummary: Separate internal evidence updates from user-facing responses. Independently activated branches share causal history, so a ready answer need not wait for reasoning to finish.

figure.alt: SyncPro independent Inner and Response generation branches

release.detail: Training/inference/evaluation code and SFT/RL checkpoint shards are public. SyncPro-189k distributes SFT annotations only: source videos and RL annotations are not included.

live-opsd-streaming-self-distillation.gallerySummary: Generate from causal context, then score the same continuation with training-only evidence hints. Distill those distributions back into the unhinted response/silence policy.

release.detail: Paper describes training and evaluation; no method-specific code, weights or data release was verified.

figure.alt: Live-OPSD privileged-context self-distillation framework

halo-human-grounded-proactivity.gallerySummary: Human judgments separate whether help is acceptable from timing and intensity errors. Agents retrieve personal evidence before choosing observation, notification, preparation or execution.

figure.alt: HALO personal environments, intervention decisions and human diagnosis

release.detail: Public environment/evaluation/annotation source and ungated HALO-8K JSONL/CSV. Controlled checkpoint evaluation, not a deployed assistant.

omni-interactscope-proactive-evaluation.gallerySummary: Evaluate event-timed tools, query-free reminders and complete guidance sequences. Correct tool names alone do not establish grounding in the unfolding event.

release.detail: Evaluation repository and public annotation/media dataset are reachable. No new model is introduced; task groups require separate reporting.

figure.alt: Omni-InteractScope intervention types and temporal targets

proactmem-event-driven-memory.gallerySummary: Validate recurring behavioral patterns against past events before using them to trigger help. Chronological structured event streams, not a native audiovisual streaming model.

release.detail: Anonymous source link is supplied by the paper, but file access could not be verified. Structured event-stream benchmark, not a video model.

price-of-scale-proactive-recall.gallerySummary: As memory grows, a fixed best-match threshold creates more false interruptions. Calibrate recall against background cues from the same memory store.

release.detail: Public experiments, generated cues, annotation items and result files; upstream benchmark corpora are separate.

evolife-active-navigation-clarification.gallerySummary: Choose movement, clarification or assistance-seeking during navigation; retain place-linked dialogue and observations for later visits. Task-conditioned help-seeking.

release.detail: Project and paper are public; method artifacts were not verified. Include for task-conditioned active help-seeking.

figure.alt: EvoLife navigation actions, active interaction and persistent spatial memory

iprefbench-infer-or-ask.gallerySummary: Separate preferences recoverable from history from facts only the user can supply. Successful mobile execution must include necessary questions, not unsupported guesses.

release.detail: Paper describes executable evaluation; no public environment/data files were verified from its links.

figure.alt: iPrefBench history-inferable and ask-only requirements

joint-gating-memory-hints.gallerySummary: Use one compact decoder for an intermediate-layer intervention gate and memory-grounded hints. Evaluate the actual gate-plus-generation pipeline, not an oracle-gate ceiling.

release.detail: Code and result artifacts are promised on publication. Derived dialogue corpus is not redistributed; no public release link or trained weights were verified.
